title: Rappler’s Dwight de Leon, Patrick Cruz nominated for best journalist at Paragala Awards
summary: Rappler multimedia reporters Dwight de Leon and Patrick Cruz are recognized for their in-depth stories on the anti-dynasty bill and the Navotas landfill fire, respectively

blocks.text: Rappler multimedia reporters Dwight de Leon and Patrick Cruz are recognized for their in-depth stories on the anti-dynasty bill and the Navotas landfill fire, respectively

MANILA, Philippines – Rappler multimedia reporters Dwight de Leon and Patrick Cruz have been nominated for the Paragala Central Luzon Media Awards, which describes itself as the biggest student award-giving body in Luzon.
The two reporters are nominees in the Best National Journalist category, alongside Christian Esguerra of Facts First and Guinevere Latoza of the Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism.
De Leon was recognized for his in-depth story examining how House leaders justify and promote a toothless anti-political dynasty bill to the public.
Cruz’s nomination, meanwhile, is for his special interactive story on the weeks-long landfill fire in Navotas, which displaced hundreds of residents.
The Paragala, organized by the Communicators’ League of Holy Angel University, is now in its 13th year.

The awards recognize communicators “whose work embodies integrity, purpose, and conviction — those who deepen public awareness, preserve collective memory, encourage critical reflection, and inspire compassion toward the realities of Filipino society.”
Visit Paragala’s social media pages for the complete list of nominees across categories. Winners will be announced on Friday, November 27. – Rappler.com
